title: Add a Back to brackets button and fix the season-picker docs
request: Follow-up to the playoffs mobile polish. Doug said yes to: add a Back to brackets button, and fix the wrong season-picker docs (the docs say the picker is pinned to the bottom on a phone; the code puts it at the top).

criteria.text: A Back to brackets button shows above the bracket whenever a bracket is open, on phone and on desktop. It is at least 44 px tall on a phone. Pressing it clears ?bracket=<id>, shows the division list and starts the page at the top. Before and after shots at 390, 360 and 320 px and at 1280 px.
criteria.evidence: Shots and measure.json: the button is 159.6 x 44 px at 390, 360, 320 and 1280 on brackets 500, 501 and 502, under the season picker and above the bracket (after/official phone and desktop bracket 500 viewed). Real touch test at 390 (after/tap, run by the builder): open the list, scroll, tap View Live Bracket, tap Back: bracket= leaves the URL, the list shows, scrollY is 0; I viewed the after-tap shot: list at the top. Unit tests: a click calls setSelectedBracketId(null) and window.scrollTo({ top: 0 }).

criteria.text: The button also shows while the Loading bracket... spinner is on screen, so a slow or stuck load has a way back. Shot on a slow network (tools/playoffs-mock.mjs FAKE_DELAY_MS).
criteria.evidence: after/loading/1 (viewed): with data delayed 6 s, the Loading bracket... spinner shows with the Back button above it. Builder tapped Back while loading: the list returned and the bracket did not reopen when the data arrived 7 s later (after/loading/2 and 3). Unit test: the button comes before the spinner in the page.

criteria.text: The button does not show on the division list. When a bracket fails to load, the page still has exactly ONE Back to brackets button (the one in the error banner). Covered by tests and a shot of the error-bracket scenario.
criteria.evidence: measure.json: button count 0 on the list at 390, 360, 320 and 1280. Error scenario shot after/error/390-error-bracket.png (viewed): exactly one Back to brackets button, the one in the error banner. The review found a state with two buttons (a loaded bracket stays up after a failed refresh); fixed in ecb59cd. tests2-RED.txt: both new tests failed with length 1 but got 2; tests2-GREEN.txt: views folder 6 files, 30 tests pass.

criteria.text: The admin view gets the same button above its bracket. It is covered by a unit test; it is NOT seen in a browser (no admin sign-in here). Reported as such.
criteria.evidence: AdminView renders the same button above BracketDetail when a bracket is open and no error banner shows (AdminView.tsx, read in the diff). Covered by AdminView.backToBrackets.test.tsx (4 tests, including the failed-refresh state). NOT seen in a browser: there is no admin sign-in here. New checklist row PLAYADMIN-38 asks a person to check it by hand.

criteria.text: Test first: the new tests fail (RED) before the code and pass (GREEN) after it. Existing playoff tests still pass. No test is skipped or weakened.
criteria.evidence: tests-RED.txt: 3 failed and 5 passed before the code (open bracket in both views, loading spinner). tests-GREEN.txt: 10 files, 38 tests pass (builder). tests2-RED.txt: 2 failed before the review fix; tests2-GREEN.txt: 6 files, 30 tests pass, run again by me. No skip, only, todo, ts-expect-error or eslint-disable in the new files (grep). Unit suite passes on 93f791b.

criteria.text: Nothing else moved: a pixel diff of before and after phone and desktop bracket shots shows only the new button row (and the content below it shifted down by the row height). No new console errors. The page does not scroll sideways at 390, 360 and 320 px.
criteria.evidence: My own pixel diff (before/nofixed against after/nofixed, fixed bars hidden, 6 shots, phone and desktop, brackets 500, 501, 502): the page grows by exactly 56 CSS px, and below the new row the old page shifted down is identical (0 changed px at threshold 20); the first changed row is just under the season picker. after/official/report.json: consoleErrors [] and overflow []. measure.json: scrollWidth equals innerWidth at 390, 360, 320 and 1280 on the list and brackets 500, 501, 502.

criteria.text: Docs: the playoffs page doc and the verification list describe the new button, and the sentence that says the page has exactly two controls is corrected. A SEPARATE commit fixes the season-picker location (top on every screen size) in the-playoffs-page.md and verification/standings.md PLAYOFF-21, checked against PlayoffPageLayout.tsx.
criteria.evidence: Docs, three commits. 833ffe3: the season-picker location fixed in 6 places (the-playoffs-page.md x3, standings.md PLAYOFF-21, run-the-playoffs.md, admin.md PLAYADMIN-02); the dated audits are left as written. 8e72c09: the button described (exactly-two-controls sentence, state diagram, Escape row, keys row, footer) and checklist rows PLAYOFF-41, PLAYOFF-42 and PLAYADMIN-38 added. 93f791b: the playoffs bottom-bar claim removed from on-a-phone.md and PHONE-17, button paragraph tightened. Checked against the PlayoffPageLayout.tsx comment and a search of src for safe-area. Two reviews read them; the second is APPROVE.

criteria.text: All required repo checks pass on the final commit and an independent code review approves it. Left alone and reported: the other 3 doc wording nits (cache time limit, pill wording in 3 rows, read-a-bracket progress bar).
criteria.evidence: All six required checks pass on 93f791b: integrity, typecheck, lint (111 s), knip, build, unit (583 s). Independent review: first CHANGES, two should-fix items fixed (ecb59cd, 93f791b), re-review APPROVE. Left alone and reported: the history step the button adds (browser Back re-opens the bracket, same as the banner button; optional follow-up: replace instead of push), the wording nit about the Loading bracket banner, 3 older doc wording nits (cache time limit, pill wording in 3 rows, read-a-bracket progress bar), checklist totals in verification/README.md, the stale comment in SeasonSelector.tsx, and focus dropping to the page after Back (same as the banner button).

reviews.summary: Independent review: first CHANGES (double button after a failed refresh; stale bottom-bar docs), both fixed and re-checked. Re-review APPROVE at 93f791b. Only wording nits remain.

history.summary: Review 1: two Back to brackets buttons showed together after a failed refresh of a loaded bracket. Fixed in ecb59cd.

review-double-button.resolved: Fixed in ecb59cd. Two new tests failed first (got 2 buttons) and pass after. Re-review APPROVE.

history.summary: Review 1: on-a-phone.md and checklist row PHONE-17 gave the playoffs page its own bottom bar. Fixed in 93f791b.
